preconditions.description: The attacker must be able to call the vulnerable function (addCoverOwner) on the contract at 0x7a250d5630B4cF539739dF2C5dAcb4c659F2488D

exploit_hint: Directly call the addCoverOwner function with the attacker's address as parameter. No special permissions or token balances are required. The function lacks access control, allowing any caller to add themselves or others as cover owners.
